title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement

---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you would like to see in Finder.

## Problem / Use Case

What problem does this feature solve? Who will benefit from it?
_e.g., As a job seeker, I want to filter recommendations by tech stack category so that I can focus on backend roles._

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of how you envision this working.

- How would the user interact with this feature?
- What changes to the UI, API, or data model might be required?

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, mockups, or architectural notes about the feature request here.
